scope: Isolated warm plume, stable versus neutral interface; not LSV formation or convergence.

metadata.model: dry anelastic; periodic horizontal; free-slip impermeable vertical boundaries; warm initial pulse only; no thermostat/sponge/bottom heat/shear/beta
metadata.name: stable
metadata.neutral_control: same bottom pressure and pulse, rebuilt neutral hydrostatic reference
metadata.budget: every SSPRK3 stage; density-weighted layer-mean vertical vorticity; native horizontal and vertical advection, Coriolis, viscosity; pressure curl checked; no horizontal forcing
metadata.interpretation: isolated plume production test, not LSV formation or a converged solution

stable.conditional_note: Eulerian w>RMS(w) and tracer C>0.001. Stretching reconstructed as -(f+zeta)*horizontal divergence; not substituted for native stage-integrated terms.

movie_scales.vorticity: zeta/f, fixed across both cases, depths and time

metadata.model: dry anelastic; periodic horizontal; free-slip impermeable vertical boundaries; warm initial pulse only; no thermostat/sponge/bottom heat/shear/beta
metadata.name: neutral
metadata.neutral_control: same bottom pressure and pulse, rebuilt neutral hydrostatic reference
metadata.budget: every SSPRK3 stage; density-weighted layer-mean vertical vorticity; native horizontal and vertical advection, Coriolis, viscosity; pressure curl checked; no horizontal forcing
metadata.interpretation: isolated plume production test, not LSV formation or a converged solution

neutral.conditional_note: Eulerian w>RMS(w) and tracer C>0.001. Stretching reconstructed as -(f+zeta)*horizontal divergence; not substituted for native stage-integrated terms.

movie_scales.vorticity: zeta/f, fixed across both cases, depths and time

native_budget: Density-weighted layer mean curl; exact SSPRK stage integration including vertical transport. Physical stretching/tilting are separate reconstructions.
fidelity_criteria: Flag <8 cells in characteristic w/N; >10% w power at wavelength<4dx; >0.1% tracer in top 5 km or outer horizontal strips. These are screening criteria, not convergence proof.
cautions: Finite amplitude 2 K thermal from rest; finite heat pulse, no continuing bottom heat.
No sponge; gravity waves can encounter the rigid lid before tracer does.
Stable and neutral hydrostatic density profiles differ above the interface.
A pressure projection is nonlocal; absence of tracer at boundaries is insufficient to prove boundary independence.
